title: Medical Secretaries and Administrative Assistants
description: Perform secretarial duties using specific knowledge of medical terminology and hospital, clinic, or laboratory procedures. Duties may include scheduling appointments, billing patients, and compiling and recording medical charts, reports, and correspondence.

tasks.text: Answer telephones and direct calls to appropriate staff.
Schedule and confirm patient diagnostic appointments, surgeries, or medical consultations.
Complete insurance or other claim forms.
Greet visitors, ascertain purpose of visit, and direct them to appropriate staff.
Transmit correspondence or medical records by mail, e-mail, or fax.
Maintain medical records, technical library, or correspondence files.
Receive and route messages or documents, such as laboratory results, to appropriate staff.
Interview patients to complete documents, case histories, or forms, such as intake or insurance forms.

Operate office equipment, such as voice mail messaging systems, and use word processing, spreadsheet, or other software applications to prepare reports, invoices, financial statements, letters, case histories, or medical records.
Perform bookkeeping duties, such as credits or collections, preparing and sending financial statements or bills, and keeping financial records.
Perform various clerical or administrative functions, such as ordering and maintaining an inventory of supplies.
Transcribe recorded messages or practitioners' diagnoses or recommendations into patients' medical records.
Compile and record medical charts, reports, or correspondence, using typewriter or personal computer.
Schedule tests or procedures for patients, such as lab work or x-rays, based on physician orders.
Prepare correspondence or assist physicians or medical scientists with preparation of reports, speeches, articles, or conference proceedings.

skills.name: Speaking
skills.def: Talking to others to convey information effectively.

skills.name: Active Listening
skills.def: Giving full attention to what other people are saying, taking time to understand the points being made, asking questions as appropriate, and not interrupting at inappropriate times.

skills.name: Service Orientation
skills.def: Actively looking for ways to help people.

skills.name: Reading Comprehension
skills.def: Understanding written sentences and paragraphs in work-related documents.

skills.name: Writing
skills.def: Communicating effectively in writing as appropriate for the needs of the audience.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.def: Using logic and reasoning to identify the strengths and weaknesses of alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to problems.

skills.name: Coordination
skills.def: Adjusting actions in relation to others' actions.

skills.name: Complex Problem Solving
skills.def: Identifying complex problems and reviewing related information to develop and evaluate options and implement solutions.

skills.name: Time Management
skills.def: Managing one's own time and the time of others.

skills.name: Monitoring
skills.def: Monitoring/Assessing performance of yourself, other individuals, or organizations to make improvements or take corrective action.

skills.name: Social Perceptiveness
skills.def: Being aware of others' reactions and understanding why they react as they do.

skills.name: Judgment and Decision Making
skills.def: Considering the relative costs and benefits of potential actions to choose the most appropriate one.

skills.name: Management of Personnel Resources
skills.def: Motivating, developing, and directing people as they work, identifying the best people for the job.

skills.name: Medical software
skills.def: Software to evaluate, plan, or redesign healthcare procedures. May include reporting or visualization features. Examples: Allscripts Payerpath, Amazing Charts, CPSI CPSI System, eClinicalWorks EHR software.

skills.name: Office suite software
skills.def: Software to provide word processing, spreadsheet, e-mail, presentations, or data management capabilities. Examples: Corel WordPerfect Office Suite, Microsoft Office software.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Word processing software
skills.def: Software to create, edit, store, or print documents. Examples: Addressing software, Google Docs, Microsoft Word.

skills.name: Accounting software
skills.def: Software to enable business functions relating to accounting, such as recording transactions or managing budgets. Examples: Accounts payable software, Accounts receivable software, Allscripts Professional PM, Intuit QuickBooks.

skills.name: Data base user interface and query software
skills.def: Software to query, present, or edit information stored in a database sytem. Examples: Data entry software, Database software, dBASE Plus, Microsoft Access.
